terms.gloss: it doesn’t square, it doesn’t fit
terms.grammar: quadrō, quadrāre, intransitive: to fit, agree
evidence: Cic. Att. 4.19.2: vīsum est hoc mihi ad multa quadrāre (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Literally “it isn’t square”: said of squared stones that fit together, then of accounts that agree and of things that suit.

sources: Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 108.
